name: Deconstruction of Emily
source:
Deconstruction of Emily follows you as the MC and your friend, Emily. Emily is a good, sweet person and your long-time co-worker. She may be having a rough time in life, but you are there for her as a friend. A not very nice friend, who only has their own objectives and interests in mind. This game will follow Emily's fall from grace, as you, the MC, choose how to corrupt her. There is no love or nice path, as you have only one objective.​

[Edited from F95Zone]
